text:
tara: quick FYI - onboarding Meridian7b-lite for internal evals. saw mismatch between kv warmup stats and golden, looks like a head-permute in our int4 packing layer. anyone else?
ben: can you paste the warmup summary?
tara: warmup stats: `mean_kv_match=0.987, headwise_stddev=0.12` vs golden `mean_kv_match=0.999, headwise_stddev=0.02`. heatmap shows heads 2 and 7 almost inverted.
oleks: head-inversion could be due to different projection ordering (qkv layout) between our kernel and the converted model. did converter record `proj_order`?
tara: hf card says `proj_order=q,k,v`. convert log says `detected proj_order=v,k,q` and we silently re-ordered to match. that re-ordering may have used wrong endianness for 2-byte packed int4 lanes.
ben: this smells like a byte-order packing bug for int4 packing across head groups. any repro?
tara: small trace: input "The quick brown fox" - compare attention weights at step 24, heads 2 and 7 differ sign.
oleks: quick mitigation: add a converter validation that checks `proj_order` against a small golden forward using fp16 and compare headwise correlations after quantization. if correlation < 0.995 flag as suspicious.
bench-bot: kicked a smoke bench 9960001240 for branch `fix/pack-endian-check`. status: running.
tara: created issue #745 - "int4 pack endianness check + proj_order validation". adding to onboarding checklist.
ben: also add a unit test for int4 pack/unpack to CI that randomizes proj_order permutations and ensures roundtrip equality.
oleks: good call. if this crosses layers we should also add a small fuzz that checks headwise cosine similarity across 20 random seeds.
tara: okay will add tests. bench results: fp16 perplexity 10.1, int4 naive 11.7, int4 with pack-endian-fix 10.15. seems fixed on smoke.
ben: merge after CI passes. note for docs: mention proj_order mismatch + packing endianness as "gotcha".
tara: will add to docs/model_onboard.md and link issue. thanks all.
